settings.coffee_intro:
Deep in the Guatemalan highlands, an elite squad of Stormtroopers marches across a remote coffee farm in pursuit of the galaxy’s most powerful beans. Their mission: seize control of the harvest and establish a bold new World Order—one cup at a time.

This is Ceiba coffee and it symbolises the connection between the land and the sky. What a glorious way to mark our return from the sky than to land on the richest soil in Guatemala.
settings.coffee_story_text: Ceiba is a bright, beautifully balanced coffee, bringing together juicy notes of cherry and apricot with a rich chocolate base and a luxuriously creamy mouthfeel. Its lively acidity and smooth, comforting finish make it a wonderfully versatile choice for a wide range of brewing methods.
settings.producer_text: This is Ceiba coffee and it symbolises the connection between the land and the sky. What a glorious way to mark our return from the sky than to land on this, the richest mountainous soil in Guatemala.
